evaluator.name: Vocabulary Evaluator (Grades 5-12)
evaluator.description: Evaluates the complexity of a text's vocabulary relative to grades 5-12, using an annotation-guide-and-rubric prompt with worked exemplars. Grades 3-4 use a different prompt, model and config: evals/student-facing-text/ela-reading/vocabulary/grades-3-4/. Unlike grades-3-4, this rubric does not use Flesch-Kincaid at all -- no {fk_score} placeholder exists in system.txt/user.txt.

steps.description: Generates a short assumption about what students at the target grade already know about the text's topic. Runs before vocab_complexity and feeds it {student_background_knowledge}. This prompt is shared with the grades-3-4 path: ../background-knowledge.txt.

NOTE 1: this step's own system.txt final line instructs the model to 'use only a single integer... don't include any other text' -- a real, verified contradiction with this contract's required JSON object (confirmed against a captured real GPT-4.1 response, sdks/settings/vocabulary/contracts.toml cases.hurricanes_grade7, which returned the full object and ignored the integer instruction). Left unedited per maintainer direction; structured output enforces this step's actual contract regardless of that prose. (Previously this line lived in user.txt; it moved to system.txt when this evaluator's prompts were standardized so system.txt carries all instructions and user.txt carries only inputs -- the contradiction itself is unchanged.) NOTE 2: scripts/check.py's eval-config check currently only validates steps[0]'s prompt files (sha256 + placeholder sync) -- see scripts/checks/eval_config.py:_prompt(). This step's system.txt/user.txt are NOT covered by that check today.
